title: acs/cycle1529 TestC1529_004_ClosureStaysDocOnly diffs the checkout against the local `main` ref for go/internal/bridge — it forbids every future bridge change on every branch instead of pinning cycle 1529's own diff
evidence: acs/cycle1529/predicates_test.go:159 runs `git diff --name-only main -- go/internal/bridge` and fails on any change; ADR-0103 unit 10 (the bridge launch-outcome leaf, by design a change under internal/bridge) trips it in its whole-module floor (2026-09-14 07:11).
CI never runs it (acs-durable runs ./acs/regression/... only), so the predicate only bites local floors; it is excluded from the console floor's ACS baseline as over-broad.
acceptance: The predicate pins cycle 1529's OWN closure commit range (its base..ship SHAs, or the docs/explain record it belongs to), not `main..worktree`.
A bridge production change on a later branch no longer fails it; cycle 1529's doc-only property still does.
notes: Same class as the cycle1638 explanation predicate (requires every changed .go since ITS base to be named by the newest record) — cycle-scoped pins that read the live tree.
surface_note: 2026-09-26 console readiness audit (read-only, against main b9553b9b): READY — files typed from the audit (test-only fix path: re-pin TestC1529_004 to cycle 1529's own recorded diff instead of the live `main` ref; no production surface is touched).
